Struggling with pain, posture issues, or symptoms that haven’t improved with traditional care?
These real, unedited chiropractic visits show how precise neck adjustments can help restore balance and improve how your body functions. Patients travel from around the world to experience this focused, results-driven approach.

Dr. Ace Thayer is a chiropractor based in Costa Mesa, California with over 30 years of clinical experience.

This channel focuses on helping people understand how targeted chiropractic care—especially precise neck adjustments—can improve mobility, reduce discomfort, and support overall body function.

Through real patient cases, Dr. Thayer demonstrates his top-down approach—often referred to as the Thayer Method—which emphasizes the connection between the brain and body.

📍 Costa Mesa, California
🎥 New videos weekly
👉 Subscribe to follow real cases, chiropractic adjustments, and education on improving movement and function
